title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-v20
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve Dedicated fleet autoscaler controls and observability for burst capacity and sustained throughput guarantees. This PR extends the autoscaler policy to expose explicit burst tokens per fleet, implements server-side enforcement to prevent noisy tenants from starving reservation pools, and surfaces per-fleet utilization and burst consumption metrics to the telemetry pipeline and Console.

What changed: added burst token accounting in the autoscaler controller; introduced a new configurable policy window (burst_window_ms) and token refill rate; added guards to enforce per-customer burst caps when Dedicated pools are constrained; implemented per-fleet utilization reporting queries and a new /internal/dedicated/metrics endpoint that returns aggregated utilization, burst_used, burst_remaining, and effective_throughput_estimate.

DB: adds a lightweight migration to store burst window and historic utilization buckets for short-term reporting (migrations/20260210_add_burst_metrics.sql).

API: Console now queries the internal metrics endpoint and shows a per-fleet "Burst usage" chart and a utilization heatmap. The autoscaler policy config accepts two new fields: burst_window_ms and burst_refill_per_min.

Testing: unit tests for token accounting and rate enforcement included; integration test for end-to-end reporting against the telemetry pipeline and a canary autoscaler run.

Rollout: feature-flag guarded behind dedicated.burst_reporting_v2; default off for existing fleets. Migration is backward compatible and idempotent.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement token accounting and enforcement
- [x] Add telemetry pipeline hooks and query views
- [x] Add migration and idempotent DB changes
- [x] Console wiring for charts (behind FF)
- [x] Unit and integration tests

Related: builds on prior autoscaler burst reporting work (see ENG-2690, ENG-3012).

b2e1f5a: telemetry: expose per-fleet utilization aggregations and new metrics endpoint
c3d2e4b: db: add migration for burst metrics buckets (20260210)
d4f5a6b: console: wire burst usage chart behind feature flag
discussion:
Ava Chen (reviewer): Overall looks good; two high-level concerns: 1) race around token refill when scaling down, 2) cost of storing short-term buckets for very large fleets.

Maya Patel (author): For 1) I added a small mutex and boundary checks in controller.go; scaling down reclaims tokens into a transient pool so we don't double-count. For 2) the migration buckets are sampled at 1s resolution but capped to last 10m per fleet and configurable via telemetry.retention.short_window; storage growth was measured in staging and is <5% for our largest fleet.

Diego Morales (reviewer): Please add an integration test that simulates a noisy tenant consuming bursts while other tenants are queued.

Maya Patel: Added tests/autoscaler/integration_test.go that run a canary autoscaler locally with a three-tenant workload and asserts fairness under token caps. CI initially failed on a flaky telemetry test.

Priya Singh (reviewer): Linted and ran locally; left one nit about naming in policy.go (burstWindowMs -> burst_window_ms) to match config.

Maya Patel: Renamed config field and updated docs. Diego approved after tests were added. Ava requested one more comment explaining the transient pool behavior; added that and squashed commits.

CI: initial pipeline failed on telemetry flaky test (timeout), rerun passed. Final CI status: pass.

Merge: Squash and merge after approvals.
release_notes: Added per-fleet burst token controls and utilization reporting for Dedicated capacity. New autoscaler policy fields (burst_window_ms, burst_refill_per_min). Console: Burst usage chart and utilization heatmap behind feature flag. Includes DB migration for short-term utilization buckets. Backwards compatible and disabled by default for existing fleets.
notes: This PR is part of the Dedicated autoscaler v2 effort; follow-up tasks: ENG-3570 (expose per-tenant drilldowns), ENG-3601 (optimize short-window storage compaction).
changelog_summary: Enhance Dedicated autoscaler with burst token enforcement and per-fleet utilization reporting; Console and telemetry integrations included.
